svg.title: Local inference path and microcontroller work
svg.desc: A client reaches a FastAPI gateway only through Tailscale Funnel. The gateway checks a SHA-256-hashed bearer token, per-token and global rate limits, JPEG magic bytes and a 512 KB body cap, then takes an async GPU lock before calling Ollama on localhost. Below: an ESP32 sharing one SPI bus between a display and a resistive touch controller, and an Arduino Uno used as a USB-serial bridge to flash an ESP32-CAM.
svg.text: Transactions keep touch at 2 MHz and the panel at full speed
Uno held in reset so its USB chip talks straight through
